"'''Cleaver'''" was a rebuilt [[2JTJ personal navigation droid]] serving the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] unit "[[Breakout Squad]]." Originally known as "'''Teejay'''," the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was destroyed during the [[Mission to Kynachi]] and was rebuilt with parts from [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] by [[Breaker (Breakout Squad)|Breaker (CT-8863)]], a clone that got his name by recognizing a [[KynachTech Industries|KynachTech]] [[C-board|circuit board]], prompting him to be renamed Cleaver due to being adept with a [[Shock stick/Legends|shock stick]].
